fl-fit-01.front: How many minutes of moderate to vigorous activity a week do Canadian guidelines suggest?
fl-fit-01.back: At least 150 minutes a week, plus strength twice a week (CSEP, 95%).

fl-fit-02.front: How many strength sessions a week?
fl-fit-02.back: At least 2, using the major muscle groups (CSEP, 95%).
